verdict.rationale: Cross-border money movement is a fair question for a banking API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only domestic Brazilian rails (Pix, TED, boletos, utilities and taxes), cards and digital-asset trading. It contains nothing on international wires, SWIFT, FX rates, or currency and corridor coverage.

support.subject: As a founder, money can cross borders — international wires or SWIFT, FX with transparent rates, and the coverage map of currencies and corridors documented
